identity.archive_digest: separate SHA-256 of complete original ZIP
identity.server_identity: skill_id and revision are trusted source facts, not archive metadata
identity.legacy: zip-v2 persisted identity is separate; never reinterpret, auto-detect or fall back to zip-v1

optional_manifest: manifest.json is ordinary content, never identity authority

zip.paths: fatal UTF-8 NFC relative POSIX; bit11 absent ASCII only; reject BOM prefix/empty/dot/dotdot/backslash/NUL/drive/duplicates/file prefixes
zip.structure: EOCD closes at EOF; contiguous local records from offset0 to central; no gaps/overlaps; matching local/central headers; exact unambiguous ZIP32 descriptor; strict extra TLV without ZIP64 or Unicode path override
zip.file_count: all non-directory entries including binary; no transcoding

frontmatter.yaml: FAILSAFE mapping; duplicate keys rejected; unknown top-level fields ignored
frontmatter.strings: nonempty exact scalar; reject trim changes and C0/DEL; lengths count UTF-16 code units

consumer_checks: exact manifest identity after byte validation
cancellation and no partial package release

validation_responsibilities.owner: Platform alone validates FAILSAFE frontmatter and publication eligibility before returning an approved exact package binding
validation_responsibilities.consumer: Agent validates an authenticated approved binding, complete ZIP SHA, archive safety and budgets, root SKILL.md UTF-8 and byte budget, raw SKILL.md identity; it does not repeat owner YAML business validation
validation_responsibilities.vectors: All vectors assert owner acceptance. owner-and-consumer vectors additionally assert consumer archive safety; owner-only negative metadata vectors are not consumer semantic oracles. They never authorize a download.
